seo_title: Gojek Case Study: B2B Content in Singapore | SOMIN
description: SOMIN read 5,967 pieces of 2023-24 media from 6 Singapore mobility brands for Gojek: Gojek made 76.79% of the B2B content, but Grab spoke more to employees.
eyebrow: Brand case study · B2B transport · Singapore
h1: Gojek makes 76.79% of B2B mobility content, but Grab sounds more human
lede: For Gojek, SOMIN read 5,967 pieces of 2023-24 media from 6 Singapore mobility brands. Gojek made 76.79% of the B2B content, yet Grab ran more variations and spoke more about employees.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · 2023 to 2024 · Singapore · B2B audiences

challenge.title: How 6 Singapore mobility brands address businesses
challenge.body: The question was what recent B2B content looked like, who it targeted and what it tried to solve.

approach.title: 5,967 pieces filtered to B2B and clustered four ways
points: Kept 2023-24: 3,703 paid and 2,264 organic pieces, 1,546 unique captions.
Split out B2B: 18.85% of content and 30.25% of ads, almost all paid.
Clustered it by persona, topic, relevance and challenge.
Compared total and unique media to separate volume from variety.
Wrote one data-driven story with society, economic and psychology angles.

findings_title: Volume, variety and employee themes in Gojek and Grab's B2B ads

findings.title: Two brands own B2B
findings.body: Gojek ran 867 B2B pieces (76.79%) and Grab 258 (22.85%). ComfortDelGro had 4; Maxi Cab, Ryde and TADA none.

findings.title: Volume is not variety
findings.body: DCO and multi-variant targeting may inflate Gojek's total; Grab has far more unique variations to test with.

findings.title: Grab talks about people
findings.body: Grab leads on employee benefits, recognition and satisfaction, alone covers B2B security and dominates vouchers.

delivered.title: 5 B2B personas, 5 topics and 4 challenge clusters for Gojek
points: Personas led by Efficiency Innovators (770 media), Efficiency Enthusiasts (206) and Financial Empowerment Champions (144)
Topics from efficient business transport and expense management (940 media) to digital gift vouchers
Analyst notes on outliers such as Thai-language content and a fire announcement
A story-generator character, angles and short story

quote.text: It is possible to have too much of a good thing if it blinds you to the needs of those who make it all possible.

outcome.title: Gojek should make B2B efficiency sound human
outcome.body: Explore employee satisfaction, a big issue for many companies that Grab already targets, and test angles with more unique variations, not volume.

faq.q: What data did the Gojek case use?
faq.a: 8,363 paid and organic pieces from 6 brands, 2016 to 2024; the B2B analysis used 5,967 from 2023-24, with paid media from 19 September 2023.
ComfortDelGro, Gojek, Grab, Maxi Cab, Ryde and TADA. Only the first three ran B2B content.
X-means clustering on ADA embeddings with SOMIN's audience, topic and insight models.
